inspiration: Bounds and water are computed from terrain instead of flood-filled; a top-down zone map from one height and water pass suits a minimap. Source: README changelog, older entries (rewrite of the bounds generator and the water calculation).
Fixture categories carry a render mode, a light ramp and a shadow offset each; one small table styles every landmark on a map. Ref MapCreator/fixtures.xml lines 3 and 17.
River types are a small enum with lava as its own class, not a recoloured water. Ref MapCreator/Classes/Constants.cs line 40.

Foliage uses a leaf-mask texture on a flat card and a per-map tree transparency setting, which keeps foliage readable without dense geometry. Ref MapCreator/data/textures/tree_leaves.png and leaves_mask.png (not read).

Landmarks come in faction variants with one footprint: keep the silhouette, change the faction ornament. Ref MapCreator/data/prerendered/objects/Hib_RelicTemple_F.png and Mid_RelicTemple_F.png (not read).
Zones carry a type tag in one XML table (outdoor, dungeon, indoor, instance, battleground, capitol), which matches zones as data on one runtime. Ref MapCreator/data/Zones.xml line 6.
